description: Assert the text of the element identified by ref or selector matches a predicate, polling until it holds or timeoutMs elapses. Provide exactly one of: equals, contains, regex, not_equals, not_contains. Optional flags (any of i, m, s, u) apply to regex; g and y are rejected as stateful. Returns: { ok, session_id, matched, actual }. Errors: EXPECTATION_FAILED (predicate not met within timeoutMs — details carry expected + actual; retryable), REF_NOT_FOUND (stale ref; carries similar_refs), TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (no/multiple predicates, invalid regex or flags, or ref+selector both/neither).

contains.description: The text must contain this substring.

equals.description: The text must equal this exactly.

flags.description: Optional regex flags (any of i, m, s, u) applied to the regex predicate; g and y are rejected as stateful. Only valid alongside a regex predicate.

not_contains.description: The text must NOT contain this substring.

not_equals.description: The text must NOT equal this.

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

regex.description: The text must match this JavaScript regular expression.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

timeoutMs.description: Max poll time in ms before EXPECTATION_FAILED (default 5000, clamped to 60000). 0 = check once.

name: electron_expect_text
title: Expect element text
